001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models;
002
003public enum KnownApiVersion {
004    // v2.1 is the API version used by software v7.1 and v7.4. It is the earliest known API version,
005    // previous pump firmware did not have Bluetooth connection compatibility.
006    API_V2_1(2, 1),
007    // v2.5 is the API version used by software v7.6 and includes remote bolus
008    API_V2_5(2, 5),
009    // stub version for all V3
010    API_V3(3, 0),
011    // v3.2 is the API version used by software v7.7 and utilizes a 6-character numeric pairing PIN
012    API_V3_2(3, 2),
013    // v3.4 is the API version used by software v7.8 for the t:slim X2
014    API_V3_4(3, 4),
015    // Tandem Mobi initial release. Software v7.6.0.3 for the Tandem Mobi (G6 CGM support only)
016    MOBI_API_V3_5(3, 5),
017    // Tandem Mobi Software v7.7.0.1 (G6 and G7 CGM support)
018    MOBI_API_V3_6(3, 6),
019    // Tandem Mobi Software v7.9.0.1 (Control-IQ Plus)
020    MOBI_API_V3_8(3, 8),
021    // Tandem Mobi Software v7.9.2.0 (Control-IQ Plus)
022    MOBI_API_V3_11(3, 11),
023    // Represents known messages from the app that we can't parse with known firmware
024    API_FUTURE(99, 99)
025    ;
026
027    private int major;
028    private int minor;
029    KnownApiVersion(int major, int minor) {
030        this.major = major;
031        this.minor = minor;
032    }
033
034    public ApiVersion get() {
035        return new ApiVersion(major, minor);
036    }
037
038    public int compareVersionTo(KnownApiVersion other) {
039        return get().compareTo(other.get());
040    }
041
042    public int compareVersionTo(ApiVersion other) {
043        return get().compareTo(other);
044    }
045
046    public boolean greaterThan(KnownApiVersion other) {
047        return compareVersionTo(other) > 0;
048    }
049
050    public boolean greaterThan(ApiVersion other) {
051        return compareVersionTo(other) > 0;
052    }
053}
